headline: Automation Scripting Specialist
summary: Automation specialist with three years of Python and Bash scripting that keeps servers, backups and network links running for an energy services company in Occidental Mindoro. My work sits between development and operations: I automate routine administration, apply security updates to Linux servers and trace failures through logs and debuggers. I want to deepen my software engineering practice.

experience.title: Automation Scripting Specialist
bullets: Wrote Python scripts that collect meter-reading files from 18 substations each night and alert the duty engineer when one is missing.
Automated Linux security updates and quarterly user-account reviews with Bash, removing about a day of manual work each month.
Keep every script in Git with reviewed merge requests and a short README, so the night shift can re-run jobs safely.
Used pdb and log analysis to find a timezone bug that had been duplicating billing exports.
Moved nightly backups to Amazon S3 with retention rules, and set firewall rules and a site-to-site VPN between the main office and substations.

experience.title: IT Technician
bullets: Handled technical support for 40 office users and kept the office network and printers running.
Wrote my first Python scripts there, renaming and archiving scanned tenant contracts each week.

skills: system security updates and access reviews

education.credential: Bachelor of Science in Computer Science
